note.en: A geographical indication says a thing is what it is because of where it is from: Darjeeling tea from those hills, Banarasi silk from those looms. Each figurine stands where the registered product comes from; India has granted several hundred, and these are a first few.
note.hi: भौगोलिक संकेतक कहता है कि कोई चीज़ जो है, वह अपने स्थान के कारण है: उन पहाड़ों की दार्जिलिंग चाय, उन करघों का बनारसी रेशम। हर मूर्ति वहीं खड़ी है जहाँ से पंजीकृत उत्पाद आता है; भारत ने कई सौ दिए हैं, ये पहले कुछ हैं।

attribution: Products, places and journal years drafted from the GI Registry's public search and each product's Wikipedia article; every item awaits review. The figurines are recipes under content/models, one per kind of thing, tinted per item.
_model: Each item names a recipe from content/models (or inherits its category's); `color` tints the parts the recipe marks tintable, so one saree serves four silks.
